description: Shared dependency policy for glockyco repositories

packageRules.description: Package managers enforce release age during lock file maintenance because Renovate cannot age the resolved dependencies.
Collect routine minor and patch updates into one PR per run. Repositories list their own groups after this preset, so those groups keep their own PRs.
Routine updates merge themselves once required checks pass and the release is three days old. Majors still wait for a person or a session.
SvelteKit packages release from one repository. Adapter majors require the matching Kit major, but Renovate's monorepo list does not cover them.
